findings.current: एजेंट सौंपें · टीम सौंपें · एजेंट: {label}। एजेंट सौंपें · टीम: {label}। टीम सौंपें
findings.problem: सौंपना is this catalogue's own verb for assign-with-a-recipient (ui.settings.shortcuts.capture.already_assigned «पहले से {label} को सौंपा गया।») and for handing a thing over (ui.browser.browser_hand_over_dialog.hand_over «सौंपें»); ui.projects.project_start_session.a_plain_session_assign_a_team_or_agent_later already says «टीम या एजेंट बाद में सौंपें।». Here the agent/team itself is the object, no recipient is named and the surface is a bare chip tooltip, so «एजेंट सौंपें» shades toward 'hand the agent over' where every other locale uses its plain assign verb (fr Attribuer, es Asignar, ru Назначить, vi Gán, zh-CN 分配, ur مقرر کریں). Understandable and internally consistent, so not a blocker: the fix is an idiom improvement, not a meaning repair. Keep the tooltip and its aria twin identical, as they are today.
findings.suggestion: एजेंट असाइन करें · टीम असाइन करें (aria twins: एजेंट: {label}। एजेंट असाइन करें · टीम: {label}। टीम असाइन करें). If the product prefers picker language: एजेंट चुनें · टीम चुनें.
findings.note: Rejecting this with 'सौंपें is the house assign term' is a defensible answer; it is recorded, not gated.

findings.current: “{name}” — {total, number} में से टर्न {turn, number} पर जाएँ
findings.problem: The sidecar describes the English order 'action … then the title after a comma'. Hindi fronts the quoted title and joins it with an em dash. Checked against the verb-final constraint: «…{total} में से टर्न {turn} पर जाएँ, “{name}”» would strand the title after the verb, and «टर्न {turn}, “{name}” पर जाएँ» would make the title the destination. The chosen order is the locale-correct adaptation, not an omission; verified rendered with 12 name shapes, all compose («“टीम, प्रमुख” — 34 में से टर्न 12 पर जाएँ»).
findings.note: Recorded as checked-and-accepted; no change requested.

findings.current: {total, number} में से टर्न {turn, number} में {clock} पर भेजे गए अपने संदेश पर जाएँ
findings.problem: {clock} is formatted by checkpointClockLabel() in src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/checkpoint-model.ts, which hardcodes `${hour12}:${minutes} ${'AM'|'PM'}` — locale-independent. The Hindi sentence takes it correctly («3:42 PM पर भेजे गए»), but a Hindi reader sees a Latin meridiem where the hi style guide expects the formatter's am/pm suffix. Code-level, not a catalogue defect and out of this batch's scope.
findings.note: Recorded so the formatter gap is not lost; the catalogue value is correct for the input it receives.
